remaining_required_inputs: Per-observation source sample start/end or an immutable native-window identity bound to the recording manifest.
Per-observation absolute UTC support start/center/end and exact receiver/visit/probe identity.
Detected pilot edge and acquisition-qualified frame timing or frame epoch for each comparison window.
Acquisition-bound absolute CFO alias/basin and residual search interval for each epoch.
Baseline support and rejection diagnostics needed to preserve the same epoch mask, including false-support controls.
A frozen held-window definition that maps exported training masks to the comparison epochs.
Read-only native samples for those bounded windows, or a versioned derived matched-pilot matrix carrying equivalent source bindings.
limitations: The export supplies track times, measured frequency, receiver, visit, RF lane, channel, and training mask; it does not supply native waveform windows or acquisition timing/alias evidence.
A 10 MS/s sample rate alone does not establish that a known pilot is present or that pilot timing and CFO alias support are valid.
The unavailable 7.5 MS/s tracking product in the frozen panel means cached tracking evidence was unavailable; it is not evidence that the raw recording failed or lacks signal content.
No IQ, model fit, geographic score, pose, or reference value was read for this handoff.
